text_en: Then the daughters of Zelophehad came forward. Zelophehad was son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh son of Joseph, a member of the Manassite clans. The names of his daughters were: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
text_cn: 那时，若瑟的儿子默纳协家族内，责罗斐哈得的女儿们前来，──责罗斐哈得是赫斐尔的儿子，赫斐尔是基肋阿得的儿子，基肋阿得是玛基尔的儿子，玛基尔是默纳协的儿子；她们的名字是玛赫拉、诺阿、曷革拉、米耳加和提尔匝。

text_en: They stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and all the congregation, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and they said,
text_cn: 她们站在梅瑟、大司祭厄肋阿匝尔、众领袖和全会众前，即会幕门口说：

text_en: “Our father died in the wilderness; he was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah, but died for his own sin; and he had no sons.
text_cn: “我们的父亲死在旷野，但他并不是科辣黑党派中，结党反抗上主的党徒，他只是因自己的罪死了，没有留下儿子。

text_en: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his clan because he had no son? Give to us a possession among our father’s brothers. ”
text_cn: 为什么让我们父亲的名字，因为没有儿子，就由本族中消灭？让我们在我们父亲的兄弟中，也分得一份产业。”

text_en: Moses brought their case before the Lord .
text_cn: 梅瑟就将她们的案件呈到上主面前；

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: The daughters of Zelophehad are right in what they are saying; you shall indeed let them possess an inheritance among their father’s brothers and pass the inheritance of their father on to them.
text_cn: “责罗斐哈得的女儿们说得有理；你应在她们的父亲兄弟中分给她们一份产业，将她们父亲的产业转让给她们。

text_en: You shall also say to the Israelites, “If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall pass his inheritance on to his daughter.
text_cn: 并且你应训示以色列子民说：一个人死了，若没有儿子，你们应将他的产业转让给他的女儿；

text_en: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
text_cn: 如果连女儿也没有，应将他的产业分给他的兄弟们。

text_en: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
text_cn: 如果连一个兄弟也没有，应将他的产业分给他父亲的兄弟们。

text_en: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the nearest kinsman of his clan, and he shall possess it. It shall be for the Israelites a statute and ordinance, as the Lord commanded Moses. ”
text_cn: 如果他的父亲也没有兄弟，应将他的产业分给他家族中与他最近的亲属，他应继承遗产：这是以色列子民当守的法令，如上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。”

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range, and see the land that I have given to the Israelites.
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你上这座阿巴陵山上去，看一看我赐给以色列子民的地方。

text_en: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,
text_cn: 你看了以后，你也要归到你亲属那里去，如你哥哥亚郎归去一样。

text_en: because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin when the congregation quarreled with me. You did not show my holiness before their eyes at the waters. ” (These are the waters of Meribath-kadesh in the wilderness of Zin. )
text_cn: 因为在亲旷野里，当会众反叛时，我命你们在他们眼前以取水显我为圣时，你们违背了我的命令。”【这是指在亲旷野中，在卡德士的默黎巴取水的事。】

text_en: Moses spoke to the Lord , saying,
text_cn: 梅瑟向上主说：

text_en: “Let the Lord , the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint someone over the congregation
text_cn: “望上主，赐给一切血肉气息的天主，委派一人管理会众，

text_en: who shall go out before them and come in before them, who shall lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the Lord may not be like sheep without a shepherd. ”
text_cn: 叫他处理他们的事件，领导他们出入，免得上主的会众如无牧之羊。”

text_en: So the Lord said to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay your hand upon him;
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你应选用农的儿子若苏厄，他是个有精神的人，按手在他身上，

text_en: have him stand before Eleazar the priest and all the congregation, and commission him in their sight.
text_cn: 叫他站在大司祭厄肋阿匝尔和全会众前，当着他们的面委派他，

text_en: You shall give him some of your authority, so that all the congregation of the Israelites may obey.
text_cn: 将你的一些威权授给他，好叫以色列子民全会众听从他。

text_en: But he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the decision of the Urim before the Lord ; at his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the Israelites with him, the whole congregation. ”
text_cn: 但他应到大司祭厄肋阿匝尔面前，请司祭为他在上主面前咨询‘乌陵’的决断，他和一切以色列子民及全会众，应依照指示去行事。”

text_en: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation;
text_cn: 梅瑟就照上主吩咐他的做了；选用了若苏厄，叫他站在大司祭厄肋阿匝尔和全会众面前，

text_en: he laid his hands on him and commissioned him—as the Lord had directed through Moses.
text_cn: 按手在他身上，委派了他，全照上主藉着梅瑟所吩咐的。
